ui.foot: Zwifanyiso zwihulukuku zwa YouTube zwa tshitshavha fhedzi. A hu na akhaunthu, a hu na u dzhenisa vhidio fhasi, a hu na u tevhela dzi-URL dzo khomarelwaho.
ui.heroIntro: Dzhenisa fhasi zwifanyiso zwihulukuku zwa YouTube na zwino nga vhukuma ho naka ho re hone, mahala. Bvisa ni vhulunge zwifanyiso zwa HD u bva kha vhidio iṅwe na iṅwe ya YouTube ya tshitshavha, Shorts, kana URL ya nga u toba luthihi. Khomarela khokagano fhasi, toba Dzhenisa tshifanyiso tshihulukuku, ngei ni dzhenise fhasi kana ni kovhekane khokagano yo lugaho.
ui.INVALID_URL: Khomarela URL ya tshitshavha ya YouTube kana (zwifanyiso zwa TikTok/Instagram a zwo ngo tikedzwa).
ui.UNSUPPORTED_HOST: Zwino hu tikedzwa dzi-URL dza tshitshavha dza YouTube na fhedzi.
ui.INVALID_VIDEO_ID: A hu na ID ya vhidio yo lugaho yo wanwaho kha khokagano yeneyo.
ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: A hu na tshifanyiso tshihulukuku tsha tshitshavha tsho wanwaho kha iyi vhidio.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Vhukhakhi ha netiweke ho ima u toda. Lingedzani hafhu.
ui.TIMEOUT: Tshifhinga tsha u toda tshifanyiso tshihulukuku tsho fhela. Lingedzani hafhu.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Tshifanyiso tshihulukuku a tsho ngo kona u khwaṱhisedzwa sa tshifanyiso tsho lugaho.
ui.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Faela a yo ngo kona u dzheniswa fhasi. Vula tshifanyiso.
ui.CHANNEL_OR_PLAYLIST: Khomarela dzi-URL dza vhidio, hu si khokagano ya tshianelwa kana mutevhe.
ui.copiedShare: Khokagano ya u kovhekana yo kopiswa
ui.copiedShares: Dzikhokagano dza u kovhekana dzo kopiswa
